#Lecture des données "curated"
def read_curated(table_name):
    base_path = "abfss://curated@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    return spark.read.parquet(f"{base_path}{table_name}/")

# Lecture
df_orders = read_curated("orders")
df_customers = read_curated("customers")
df_products = read_curated("products")
df_inventory = read_curated("inventory")
df_categories = read_curated("categories")
df_shipments = read_curated("shipments")
df_loyalty_points = read_curated("loyalty_points")
df_promotions = read_curated("promotions")
df_suppliers = read_curated("suppliers")
df_returns = read_curated("returns")
df_reviews= read_curated("reviews")
df_payments = read_curated("payments")
df_warehouses = read_curated("warehouses")
df_customer_addresses = read_curated("customer_addresses")
df_order_items = read_curated("order_items")

from pyspark.sql.functions import min as spark_min, max as spark_max

#Analyse des plages de dates des tables

print("Orders")
df_orders.select(spark_min("order_date"), spark_max("order_date")).show()

print("Payments")
df_payments.select(spark_min("payment_date"), spark_max("payment_date")).show()

print("Shipments")
df_shipments.select(spark_min("ship_date"), spark_max("delivery_date")).show()

print("Returns")
df_returns.select(spark_min("return_date"), spark_max("return_date")).show()

print("Reviews")
df_reviews.select(spark_min("review_date"), spark_max("review_date")).show()

print("Inventory")
df_inventory.select(spark_min("last_restock_date"), spark_max("last_restock_date")).show()
### **<mark>Création de la dimensions dim_date</mark>**

#Générer toutes les dates entre 2020 et 2025
from pyspark.sql.functions import date_format,col,when,year,quarter,month,weekofyear,dayofmonth,dayofweek
df_date_range = spark.sql("""
    SELECT explode(sequence (to_date('2020-01-01'),to_date('2024-12-31'),interval 1 day)) as date
""")
#création de la dimension dim_date
dim_date = df_date_range\
    .withColumn("date_id", date_format(col("date"), "yyyyMMdd").cast("integer"))\
    .withColumn("year", year(col("date")))\
    .withColumn("quarter", quarter(col("date")))\
    .withColumn("month", month(col("date")))\
    .withColumn("month_name", date_format(col("date"), "MMMM"))\
    .withColumn("week", weekofyear(col("date")))\
    .withColumn("day", dayofmonth(col("date")))\
    .withColumn("day_name", date_format(col("date"), "EEEE"))\
    .withColumn("day_of_week", dayofweek(col("date")))\
    .withColumn("semester", when(col("month") <= 6, 1).otherwise(2))\
    .withColumn("is_weekend", when(col("day_of_week").isin(1, 7), True).otherwise(False))

print(f"Lignes générées : {dim_date.count()}")
dim_date.show(5)

dim_date.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    "abfss://enriched@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/dim_date/"
### <mark>**Création de la dimensions - dim_warehouses**</mark>

df_warehouses.printSchema()
df_warehouses.show(5)
print(f"Nombre de lignes : {df_warehouses.count()}")

dim_warehouses = df_warehouses

dim_warehouses.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    "abfss://enriched@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/dim_warehouses/"
### <mark>**Création de la dimesion - dim_promotions**</mark>

df_promotions.printSchema()
df_promotions.show(5)
print(f"Nombre de lignes : {df_promotions.count()}")

dim_promotions = df_promotions.drop("diff_days")

dim_promotions.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    "abfss://enriched@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/dim_promotions/"
### <mark>**Création de la dimension - dim_products**</mark>

print("Nombre de products:", df_products.count())
print("Nombre de categories:", df_categories.count())
print("Nombre de suppliers:", df_suppliers.count())

print("Nombre de category_id distincts dans categories:", df_categories.select("category_id").distinct().count())
print("Nombre de supplier_id distincts dans suppliers:", df_suppliers.select("supplier_id").distinct().count())
df_suppliers.show(2)

dim_products = df_products\
    .join(df_categories.select("category_id","category_name","parent_category"), on = "category_id", how = "left")\
    .join(df_suppliers.select("supplier_id","supplier_name",col("country").alias("supplier_country"),
        col("rating").alias("supplier_rating")),on="supplier_id",how="left")
print(f"nombre de lignes : {dim_products.count()}")
dim_products.show(5)

dim_products.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    "abfss://enriched@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/dim_products/"
### <mark>**création de la dimension - dim_customers**</mark>

from pyspark.sql.functions import count as spark_count

df_customer_addresses.filter(col("is_default") == True) \
    .groupBy("customer_id") \
    .agg(spark_count("*").alias("nb_default")) \
    .groupBy("nb_default").count().show()
df_customer_addresses.show(4)
df_customer_addresses.select("customer_id").distinct().count()
df_customers.show(4)

# Nombre total de clients
print("Total clients:", df_customers.count())
print("Total clients:", df_customer_addresses.count())

# Nombre de clients ayant au moins 1 adresse par défaut
print("Clients avec adresse par défaut:", 
      df_customer_addresses.filter(col("is_default") == True).select("customer_id").distinct().count())

# Nombre de clients SANS adresse par défaut du tout
clients_sans_defaut = df_customers.select("customer_id") \
    .join(
        df_customer_addresses.filter(col("is_default") == True).select("customer_id"),
        on="customer_id", how="left_anti"
    )
print("Clients SANS adresse par défaut:", clients_sans_defaut.count())

orphan_addresses = df_customer_addresses.select("customer_id").distinct() \
    .join(df_customers.select("customer_id"), on="customer_id", how="left_anti")

print("customer_id dans customer_addresses mais absents de customers:", orphan_addresses.count())
#extrait de l'adresse principale de chaque client
df_default_address = df_customer_addresses.filter(col("is_default") == True)

from pyspark.sql.functions import sum as spark_sum
#agrège les points de fidélité par client 
df_loyalty_agg = df_loyalty_points.groupBy("customer_id").agg(
    spark_sum("points_earned").alias("total_points_earned"),
    spark_sum("points_redeemed").alias("total_points_redeemed")
)

print("Nombre de clients avec historique loyalty:", df_loyalty_agg.count())
df_loyalty_agg.show(5)

dim_customers = df_customers \
    .join(
        df_default_address.select(
            "customer_id",
            col("street"),
            col("city"),
            col("postal_code"),
            col("country")
        ),
        on="customer_id", how="left"
    ) \
    .join(
        df_loyalty_agg,
        on="customer_id", how="left"
    ) \
    .fillna({"total_points_earned": 0, "total_points_redeemed": 0})

print(f"Nombre de lignes : {dim_customers.count()}")  
dim_customers.show(5)

dim_customers.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    "abfss://enriched@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/dim_customers/"
### <mark>**Création de la table de fait - fact_sales**</mark>

# order_id unique dans orders 
print("Total orders:", df_orders.count())
print("order_id distincts dans orders:", df_orders.select("order_id").distinct().count())

# order_id qui n'existent pas dans orders 
orphan_orders = df_order_items.select("order_id").distinct() \
    .join(df_orders.select("order_id"), on="order_id", how="left_anti")
print("order_id orphelins dans order_items:", orphan_orders.count())
orphan_orders = df_orders.select()

orphan_products_sales = df_order_items.select("product_id").distinct() \
    .join(df_products.select("product_id"), on="product_id", how="left_anti")

print("product_id orphelins dans order_items:", orphan_products_sales.count())

lignes_orphelines_sales = df_order_items.join(
    df_products.select("product_id"), on="product_id", how="left_anti"
)
print("Lignes concernées:", lignes_orphelines_sales.count())
print("Total lignes order_items:", df_order_items.count())

from pyspark.sql.functions import round as spark_round
fact_sales = df_order_items.join(
    df_orders.select(
        "order_id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "promotion_id",
        "shipping_address_id"
    ),
    on="order_id",
    how="inner"
).join(
    df_products.select("product_id"),
    on="product_id",
    how="inner"
).withColumn(
    "line_total",
    spark_round(col("quantity") * col("unit_price") * (1 - col("discount_applied")), 2)
).withColumn(
    "date_id",
    date_format(col("order_date"), "yyyyMMdd").cast("integer")
)

print(f"Nombre de lignes : {fact_sales.count()}")

from pyspark.sql.functions import date_format
#Créer date_id pour la jointure
fact_sales = fact_sales.withColumn(
    "date_id",
    date_format(col("order_date"), "yyyyMMdd").cast("integer")
)

fact_sales.select("order_date", "date_id").show(5)

fact_sales.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    "abfss://enriched@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/fact_sales/"
### <mark>**Création de la table de fait - fact_payments**</mark>

orphan_payments = df_payments.select("order_id").distinct() \
    .join(df_orders.select("order_id"), on="order_id", how="left_anti")

print("order_id orphelins dans payments:", orphan_payments.count())

lignes_orphelines_payments = df_payments.join(
    df_orders.select("order_id"), on="order_id", how="left_anti"
)
print("Lignes de payments concernées:", lignes_orphelines_payments.count())
print("Total lignes payments:", df_payments.count())
print("Pourcentage:", round(lignes_orphelines_payments.count() / df_payments.count() * 100, 2), "%")

fact_payments = df_payments.join(
    df_orders.select("order_id"), on="order_id", how="inner"
).withColumn(
    "date_id",
    date_format(col("payment_date"), "yyyyMMdd").cast("integer")
)

print(f"Nombre de lignes : {fact_payments.count()}")  
fact_payments.show(5)

fact_payments.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    "abfss://enriched@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/fact_payments/"
### **<mark>Création dea la table de fait - fact_shipments</mark>**

lignes_orphelines_shipments = df_shipments.join(
    df_orders.select("order_id"), on="order_id", how="left_anti"
)
print("Lignes de shipments concernées:", lignes_orphelines_shipments.count())
print("Total lignes shipments:", df_shipments.count())
print("Pourcentage:", round(lignes_orphelines_shipments.count() / df_shipments.count() * 100, 2), "%")

fact_shipments = df_shipments.join(
    df_orders.select("order_id"), on="order_id", how="inner"
).withColumn(
    "ship_date_id",
    date_format(col("ship_date"), "yyyyMMdd").cast("integer")
).withColumn(
    "delivery_date_id",
    date_format(col("delivery_date"), "yyyyMMdd").cast("integer")
).drop("tracking_number")

print(f"Nombre de lignes : {fact_shipments.count()}")  
fact_shipments.show(5)

fact_shipments.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    "abfss://enriched@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/fact_shipments/"
### <mark>**Création de table de fait - fact_returns**</mark>

lignes_orphelines_returns = df_returns.join(
    df_orders.select("order_id"), on="order_id", how="left_anti"
)
print("Lignes de returns concernées:", lignes_orphelines_returns.count())
print("Total lignes returns:", df_returns.count())
print("Pourcentage:", round(lignes_orphelines_returns.count() / df_returns.count() * 100, 2), "%")

fact_returns = df_returns.join(
    df_orders.select("order_id"), on="order_id", how="inner"
).withColumn(
    "date_id",
    date_format(col("return_date"), "yyyyMMdd").cast("integer")
)

print(f"Nombre de lignes : {fact_returns.count()}")
fact_returns.show(5)

fact_returns.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    "abfss://enriched@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/fact_returns/"
### <mark>**Création de la table de fait - fact_reviews**</mark>

# Orphelins côté customer_id
orphan_customers_reviews = df_reviews.select("customer_id").distinct() \
    .join(df_customers.select("customer_id"), on="customer_id", how="left_anti")
print("customer_id orphelins dans reviews:", orphan_customers_reviews.count())

# Orphelins côté product_id
orphan_products_reviews = df_reviews.select("product_id").distinct() \
    .join(df_products.select("product_id"), on="product_id", how="left_anti")
print("product_id orphelins dans reviews:", orphan_products_reviews.count())

# Lignes concernées au total
lignes_orphelines_reviews = df_reviews.join(
    df_customers.select("customer_id"), on="customer_id", how="left_anti"
).union(
    df_reviews.join(df_products.select("product_id"), on="product_id", how="left_anti")
).distinct()
print("Lignes reviews concernées (au moins un id orphelin):", lignes_orphelines_reviews.count())
print("Total lignes reviews:", df_reviews.count())

fact_reviews.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    "abfss://enriched@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/fact_reviews/"
### **<mark>Création de a table de fait - fact_inventory</mark>**

# Orphelins côté product_id
orphan_products_inv = df_inventory.select("product_id").distinct() \
    .join(df_products.select("product_id"), on="product_id", how="left_anti")
print("product_id orphelins dans inventory:", orphan_products_inv.count())

# Orphelins côté warehouse_id
orphan_warehouses_inv = df_inventory.select("warehouse_id").distinct() \
    .join(df_warehouses.select("warehouse_id"), on="warehouse_id", how="left_anti")
print("warehouse_id orphelins dans inventory:", orphan_warehouses_inv.count())

# Lignes concernées au total
lignes_orphelines_inv = df_inventory.join(
    df_products.select("product_id"), on="product_id", how="left_anti"
).union(
    df_inventory.join(df_warehouses.select("warehouse_id"), on="warehouse_id", how="left_anti")
).distinct()
print("Lignes inventory concernées:", lignes_orphelines_inv.count())
print("Total lignes inventory:", df_inventory.count())

fact_inventory.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    "abfss://enriched@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/fact_inventory/"
